protocol.source: saved reset-preflight real-neural teacher 830 Q scores, approval of public proposal
protocol.training: one 24-round Strategy B episode at opponent seed 41000
protocol.evaluation: initial/final frozen disconnected 72 rounds, opponent seeds 52000/52003/52004
protocol.schedule: 150Hz VPN 0-240ms; count reset 50ms; VPN-spike head route and provisional action 240ms; 300Hz DN 240-280ms; action/reward 280ms; Q update 620ms; student-only reset between 680ms rounds
protocol.heads: three cue-specific three-action MBON-Q heads plus cue-free head; alpha .03, epsilon .20; original selected-action reward-prediction update
protocol.streams: archived key schedule; neural key+2, proposal key+501, rejection key+701, shuffle rng(2026110601+seed)

gates.receiver: archived >=10/12 cue recognition and no message loss; actual DN decoding and target dominance
gates.shuffle: >=4/23 positions, bit counts preserved, <=60% balanced quality
gates.reliablePolicy: >=17/23 each cue, >=58/72 total, >=12 of each action over 69 observed rounds
gates.total: >=8/72 above own initial, >=4/72 above archived shared-correct, >=4/72 above each cue-head shuffled/untrained/disconnected for both students
